label: 7-Zip
description: Free file archiver (zip, 7z, rar and more). Installed for every user on this computer; may ask for administrator permission once. Does nothing if 7-Zip is already installed, and uninstall only removes it if this setup installed it.
notes: Probed on windows-latest (winget 1.11): NSIS exe, machine scope only (--scope user -> 0x8A150010), install ~6 s, winget uninstall ~2 s and synchronous. 7-Zip ships on the runner image, so scenarios remove it first.
